about: Wavenum community minerals pack: reference peaks for minerals not yet in RRUFF or the Raman Open Database, taken from the published literature. Each entry needs name, formula, system, technique, peaks [[position, relative intensity 0-100], ...] and source (a DOI or URL). Add new minerals by pull request; see README.md in this folder. Curated by Kishan Tiwari <kishantiwari@iitkgp.ac.in>.

minerals.name: Wangdaodeite
minerals.note: Suizhou L6 chondrite (Xie et al. 2020, Meteorit. Planet. Sci.). Band centres of the reported ranges 174-179, 273-277, 560-567, 738-743 cm-1; the 738-743 band is diagnostic. Relative intensities approximate.

minerals.name: Akimotoite
minerals.note: NWA 5011 L6 chondrite shock vein. 799 cm-1 is the main band. Relative intensities approximate.

minerals.name: Hemleyite
minerals.note: Suizhou L6 chondrite (Bindi et al. 2017, Sci. Rep.). Fe analogue of akimotoite; strongest band near 795 cm-1. Relative intensities approximate.

minerals.name: Majorite
minerals.note: Majoritic garnet in Sixiangkou L6 chondrite shock veins. 930 cm-1 is the most consistently reported band. Relative intensities approximate.

minerals.name: Poirierite (calculated)
minerals.note: First-principles calculated Raman bands below 900 cm-1 (Tomioka et al. 2021, Commun. Earth Environ.); not a measured spectrum.
